name: Kettlebell swing
description: Hinge at the hips and snap the kettlebell up to chest height using your hips.
caution: Hinge from the hips, not the lower back. Keep the arms loose and the core tight.

name: Thruster
description: Squat with dumbbells at your shoulders, then drive up and press them overhead in one motion.

name: Mountain climber
description: From a plank, drive your knees toward your chest in quick alternation.

name: Battle rope waves
description: Alternate arm waves with the ropes, keeping your core braced.

name: Bear crawl
description: Move forward on hands and feet with knees just off the floor and your back flat.

name: Sprint intervals
description: Run hard for a short distance, then walk or jog to recover before repeating.
caution: Warm up for ten minutes first. Stop if you feel chest pain or dizziness.

name: Medicine ball slam
description: Raise the ball overhead and slam it to the floor with force.

name: Burpee
description: Drop to a push-up, jump your feet in, then jump up with your arms overhead.

name: Box step-over
description: Step up onto a box one leg at a time, then step down, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Plank to push-up
description: Move from forearms to hands in a plank, then return to forearms.
